Follow-up items in §9 are labelled '建議程序，不是已完成的事實' and keep any objective task, consent, rubric and dataset separate. No recommendation is presented as completed."
    },

The new wording aligns with §4.1 and §10.2 and creates no new contradiction; the four declared wording-only edits are present and no numeric fixture changed."

        "p.30–32 最終檢核與聲明"

      "finding": "Phrasing is readable Traditional Chinese and tables/instructions are self-contained: units, denominators, totals, means, differences and HOLD/REJECT actions are defined where used, and the 80-row locator table can be followed row by row. The only usability drags are the very dense landscape register/locator pages (p.20–28); no dependence on this review packet is required."

Short note: Semantic review of exact final9 SHA `56f433e095f32378f2fd8241c1a27948d2bfe6748da003af5623d265885edb68` is PASS across A–I, with arithmetic PASS and no blocking defects. The three prior final8 H-level items are resolved on final9: §1.5 now cites the existing §8.3, the two checklist claims now match the mixed portrait/landscape layout, and 表3-2 no longer contains the four-digit-code wording. Formal acceptance remains **NOT_GRANTED** because the artifact is SAMPLE/SYNTHETIC, the official printed serial is UNKNOWN, exact-byte/source binding is external, and REAL/visual gates remain separate.
